dedupe_keys.name: arcep benin telecom market observatory and weekly mobile quality of service indicators

description: ARCEP Bénin, the regulator of electronic communications and post in Benin, publishes a market observatory and quality of service results on its website. The observatory has sections for Internet, internet tariffs, fixed telephony, mobile telephony, postal services, quality of service and mobile financial services, and the regulator posts weekly articles with the quality of service indicators of the mobile networks (for example the weeks of 29 August to 4 September, 5 to 11 September and 12 to 18 September 2026). Earlier field measurement campaigns are released as PDF control results (for example 1 to 10 June 2023), and annual activity reports for 2024 and 2025 summarise the market. Coverage is national; resolution is per operator and per reporting period. Format and access: web pages and PDF reports; no bulk download or API was seen. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: the site resets connections from some networks, the observatory pages were not all readable from the cloud, and indicators are reported in prose and images, not tables. Simulation uses: operator-level network performance and subscriber figures for telecom resilience and service performance analysis in West Africa. Related records: comparable to the AGER São Tomé telecom statistical indicators and the ECTEL Eastern Caribbean sector review.
